import OAI.RingTheory.DirectFiniteness.PrescribedOutputs

namespace OAI

namespace KaplanskyCounterexample

/-- A finite field of characteristic two and a finitely generated group admit
finite group-algebra sums with a right inverse that is not a left inverse. -/
theorem main_theorem : MainClaim := Prescription.Output.prescribed_main

end KaplanskyCounterexample

end OAI
